subject: Welcome to AcmeAI – Next Steps for Onboarding
body:
Hi Rajesh,

Thank you for choosing AcmeAI for your intelligent automation needs. We are excited to work with ClientCorp on this engagement.

As discussed during our call yesterday, the next step is onboarding. I am looping in our technical lead and customer success team to kick off the process.

Could you please confirm your availability this week for a kickoff call and share the primary point of contact from your side?

Best regards,
Ankit
Sales Manager
AcmeAI

subject: Re: Welcome to AcmeAI – Next Steps for Onboarding
body:
Hi Ankit,

Thanks for the warm welcome. We are looking forward to working with AcmeAI as well.

I will be the primary point of contact from ClientCorp. For technical discussions, I will involve our IT manager, Neha Sharma.

I am available on Thursday between 2 PM and 4 PM IST for the kickoff call. Please let me know if that works.

Regards,
Rajesh Kumar
Head of Operations
ClientCorp

subject: Kickoff Call Confirmation and Agenda
body:
Hi Rajesh,

Thursday at 3 PM IST works for us. I have scheduled a meeting and shared the calendar invite.

Agenda for the call:

Project overview and goals
Scope confirmation
Data access requirements
Timeline and milestones
Roles and responsibilities

Please feel free to add any additional points.

Regards,
Pooja
Customer Success Manager

subject: Re: Kickoff Call Confirmation and Agenda
body:
Hi Pooja,

Agenda looks good. I would like to add a discussion on data privacy and compliance requirements as well, since our data involves customer information.

See you on the call.

Regards,
Rajesh

subject: Pre-Kickoff: Technical Information Required
body:
Hi Rajesh,

Ahead of the kickoff call, it would be helpful if you could share:

Current system architecture overview
APIs available for integration
Data formats (CSV, JSON, DB access, etc.)
Preferred deployment (cloud or on-premise)

This will help us prepare better.

Thanks,
Sanket
Technical Lead

subject: Re: Pre-Kickoff: Technical Information Required
body:
Hi Sanket,

I have attached a high-level architecture diagram. We primarily use REST APIs and JSON data formats.

Deployment preference is cloud, preferably AWS, but we need to review compliance constraints internally.

More details can be discussed during the call.

Regards,
Rajesh

subject: Invoice and Payment Terms for AcmeAI Subscription
body:
Hi Rajesh,

As per our agreement, please find attached the invoice for the initial onboarding and first month subscription.

Payment terms are net 15 days. Let us know if you require a PO or vendor registration from your side.

Regards,
Meera
Finance Team

subject: Re: Invoice and Payment Terms
body:
Hi Meera,

Thanks for sharing the invoice. Our finance team requires a signed contract and vendor onboarding form before processing payment.

Could you please share the required documents?

Regards,
Rajesh

subject: Contract and Data Processing Agreement
body:
Hi Rajesh,

Please find attached the Master Service Agreement and Data Processing Agreement for review.

Let us know if your legal team has any comments or required changes.

Best,
Rohit
Legal Counsel

subject: Re: Contract and Data Processing Agreement
body:
Hi Rohit,

We have reviewed the documents. There are a few clauses related to data retention and liability that our legal team would like to discuss.

I have added comments in the attached document.

Regards,
Rajesh
